purpose: Bind the historical JIT, AOT, tiering, Test262, performance, and claim records to the code paths and artifacts that actually exist. The ledger preserves useful scaffolding while preventing planning records, input-only hashes, synthetic timings, test-only paths, or observed failures from being promoted into production-success claims.
assumptions: The repository root contains the canonical .beads/issues.jsonl and docs/claim_to_proof_matrix_v1.json snapshots used by the validator.
Git tracking state is part of reproducibility truth: an ignored working-tree artifact can support local diagnosis but cannot by itself support a fresh-clone observed claim.

A local_optional proof retains its historical path and hash, is fully revalidated when present, and emits an explicit absence event when missing; it never substitutes for required or Git-tracked closure evidence.
Observed performance and conformance failures remain valuable evidence; observed describes the measurement, not success against the target.

Opportunity and relevance scores are ordinal 1-100 planning signals, not probabilities or measured effect sizes; S, M, L, and XL budgets describe relative engineering scope and exclude external-dependency latency.
QuickJS- and V8-named native lanes are compatibility-era profile names, not bindings to those engines.
exclusions: This ledger does not implement native code generation, AOT images, Test262 harness parity, or performance optimizations.
This ledger does not promote or rewrite claim-matrix rows; BRIDGE-00.2 owns claim-language correction after this crosswalk is accepted.
This ledger does not delete, rewrite, or retroactively relabel historical artifacts.
ECMA-402, Annex B, post-ES2020 proposals, and host-specific Test262 cases remain outside the declared es2020-normative denominator.

classification_definitions.executable: A real parser, validator, runner, planner, benchmark, or runtime path executes rather than existing only as prose or a type declaration.
classification_definitions.observed: A real run produced measurements or decisions. Observed does not imply that a target passed.
classification_definitions.planning_provenance: The surface records plans, identities, guards, lineage, or future backend intent but is not itself the claimed executable output.
classification_definitions.production_wired: The surface reaches the same native parse-lower-execute path used by shipped runtime orchestration, not merely a fixture or isolated model.
classification_definitions.simulated: The implementation deliberately models the claimed operation without executing the real backend or effect.
classification_definitions.synthetic_estimate: A duration, size, hash, or outcome is derived from a formula or label rather than measured from the claimed output.
classification_definitions.test_only: The evidence is exercised by tests, CI, benchmarks, or audit tooling and is not itself a shipped runtime execution lane.

revalidation.fallback: publish the last valid coverage bundle with its cutoff and limitations
revalidation.kill_rule: block any use of execution coverage as a conformance pass rate
revalidation.rollback: restore the prior summary and report the new run as rejected evidence

subjects.title: Test262 conformance via a provisional checked-in es2020-normative vector subset; full-suite conformance is TARGETED.
subjects.runtime_reality: Both a three-vector checked-in gate and a real 47,157-case native execution run exist; the latter passes 120 cases and explicitly disallows a full-suite claim because Test262 harness includes are not preloaded
subjects.user_impact: Users get transparent, reproducible evidence of the current gap instead of silent expected-failure lists
limitations: The live runner discards includes, flags, features, and structured negative metadata during vector conversion.
The declared scope excludes ECMA-402, Annex B, and post-ES2020 proposals.
Production-wired means the runner reaches the native engine path; it does not mean the harness is production functionality.
downstream_decisions: Keep full-suite conformance targeted.
Promote only when the declared es2020-normative denominator has zero unwaived semantic failures and the waiver ledger contains only valid host/harness exclusions.

proofs.interpretation: The real-corpus artifact is observed and explicitly bounded.
The live corpus is real, but conversion retains only the reduced vector fields.

revalidation.trigger: the Test262 pin, profile, harness, vector schema, waiver, or pass rate changes
revalidation.fallback: publish the bounded provisional and real-corpus lower-bound artifacts separately
revalidation.kill_rule: block full-conformance wording while full_suite_claim_allowed is false or unwaived semantic failures remain
revalidation.rollback: restore prior target wording and preserve the failed measurement for frontier triage

findings.summary: The closed Cranelift-tier bead produced planning and guard records but no linked backend or native execution path.
findings.score_rationale: This directly controls the raw-performance ceiling and corrects a closed implementation claim that lacks executable output.
findings.implementation_budget: XL: native lowering, deoptimization, executable-memory policy, cache integration, and platform hardening

findings.summary: The closed AOT lane emits input identities and synthetic timing, not executable image bytes.
findings.score_rationale: A real executable image and loader are required for cold-start specialization and for any AOT wording to be defensible.
findings.implementation_budget: XL: image format, lowering, loader, content-addressed cache, invalidation, and safe fallback

findings.summary: Test262 includes and other normative metadata are parsed then discarded before native evaluation.
findings.score_rationale: Lossless metadata and harness preloads are the cheapest credible multiplier on the measured conformance pass rate.
findings.implementation_budget: M: lossless metadata model, include preload, flag semantics, negative expectations, and async completion

findings.summary: The coverage summary contradicts itself about whether the stricter harness preloads Test262 includes.
findings.score_rationale: The correction is small but prevents execution coverage from being mistaken for conformance and protects the campaign denominator.
findings.implementation_budget: S: reconcile profile wording, regenerate the coverage bundle, and ratchet the contradiction check

findings.summary: The closed Track-G replacement bead delivered real Lean, Z3, bounded-sample, and proof-emitter paths, and the matrix now records those paths accurately; FE-CLAIM-016 through FE-CLAIM-021 must remain hypotheses because complete target coverage, supported generator coverage, tracked proof bundles, and independent rechecks are still missing.
findings.score_rationale: Completing and independently rechecking the missing proof bundles has high claim-integrity value but is less immediate than the execution-tier and conformance blockers.
findings.implementation_budget: L: tracked complete proof bundles, supported generator coverage, promotion rules, and independent replay

findings.summary: The May performance pass is a real local observation, but its artifact tree is ignored and unavailable to fresh-clone verifiers.
findings.score_rationale: Every optimization decision needs a durable, clean-clone baseline or apparent wins can be comparator and artifact drift.
findings.implementation_budget: M: tracked raw samples, pinned comparators, reproducible runner, and clean-clone verification

findings.summary: QuickJS and V8 lane names identify two configurations of one native interpreter, not distinct execution engines or optimized tiers.
findings.score_rationale: Canonical lane ownership removes misleading architecture signals and reduces the dual-lane tax on every semantic and performance fix.
findings.implementation_budget: L: canonical-lane decision, compatibility alias retirement, parity gates, and module graduation

findings.summary: The claim-to-proof matrix gate and claim-evidence integrity capstone exist and check real tracked state but are absent from all current GitHub workflows.
findings.score_rationale: This is a small integration change with disproportionate leverage against silent claim and evidence regression.
findings.implementation_budget: S: workflow wiring, branch-protection requirement, failure artifacts, and retention policy

findings.summary: FE-CLAIM-025's tracked env, manifest, and repro metadata use hard-coded patterned schema_hash constants instead of computed schema digests, while repro.lock prescribes cargo clean, direct Cargo, an absolute historical workspace, and a stale source revision.
findings.score_rationale: An integrity claim cannot rely on patterned pseudo-hashes or an unsafe, stale reproduction recipe.
findings.implementation_budget: M: computed schema identities, safe rch reproduction, source rebinding, and evidence regeneration
